title: Combinatorial study of the q-Catalan triangle and its generalizations
summary: We announce a series of results on the combinatorial study of the q-Catalan triangle (C_{n,k}(q)), defined by C_{n,0}(q)=q^{n(n-1)/2} and C_{n,k}(q)=C_{n,k-1}(q)+q^{n-k-1}C_{n-1,k}(q). We establish combinatorial interpretations via a universal combinatorial family of seven components: four families of pattern-avoiding permutations weighted by inversion or co-inversion statistics, Dyck paths, binary words and triangulations.
